children.label: 1-H. Changing parameter values with a mutable Param

children.value: A parameter can be specified to be mutable. This tells Pyomo that the value of the parameter may change in the future, and allows the user to change the parameter value and resolve the problem without the need to rebuild the entire model each time. We will use this functionality to find a better solution to the knapsack problem. We would like to find when the wrench becomes valuable enough to be a part of the optimal solution. Create a Pyomo Parameter for the value of the items, make it mutable, and then write a loop that prints the solution for different wrench values.
